Hi Patrick,

Thanks for writing in, and sorry for the hassle. To set expectations honestly: Moken is a separate company. We partner with them (the free Pro months that come with some of our DePIN hardware), but we do not build or host their tracker, and I have no visibility into their service status or your account there from my side. I also could not reach their site from my tools just now, so I cannot tell you from here whether it is down for everyone or something specific to your account.

A few things worth ruling out on your end, since they cover most of what we hear. First, try the site in a private or incognito window, or in a different browser, with any ad blocker or privacy extension disabled for that domain. Their dashboard pulls live data from several network APIs, and blockers tend to break the charts and leave blank panels that look like a dead site. Second, clear cookies for the domain and sign in again. A stale session token after one of their updates will show you a logged in page that never loads data. Third, if you are on a VPN, turn it off for one attempt. If the pages render fine after any of those, it was local rather than a broken site.

If none of that changes anything, it is on their side and worth reporting to Moken directly through their own support or community channels, since they are the only ones who can look at your account and their API status.

I have passed this to our team with your email so they can check with their Moken contact whether there is a known outage or a problem with the free Pro months attached to your purchases. The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to you by email. If any of your actual HeliumDeploy hardware is misbehaving alongside this, tell me the model and what it is doing and I will work through it with you.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
